_comment: Real in-sim aircraft bounding boxes (metres) from BUSURVEY exports, used by the occupancy registry when pydcs understates a footprint. pydcs 'width' is often a swept/stored span; DCS reports the model's true envelope (e.g. F-14 span 20.34 m vs pydcs 10.15 m), so GSE/statics were spawning under spread wingtips. Keyed by DCS type id. Only entries here override pydcs; everything else falls back to pydcs width/length. Adding an entry changes generated placement for that type (byte-affecting) — for a type already in released missions, call it out as a versioned change.

_F-14B_observed.note: pydcs says 16.6 x 10.15; real box larger. NOT applied yet — changing it alters existing F-14B missions' bytes; do as a deliberate versioned data pass.
